programme.title: Growing Through Life
programme.desc: HOI SING (Raymond Lam) and his mother HO WAI-SUM (Lui Yau Wai) have been running a domestic appliance manufacturing factory. SING's uncle HOI LEUNG (Lau Chung Yan) is a money-minded snob who has been seeking to acquire the factory by whatever means. LEUNG's wife CHENG MING-CHU (Cecilia Yip) and daughter HOI MEI-SZ (Toby Leung) try to intercede for SING and finally manages to convince the man to put the acquisition on hold. Eager to covet the plant site, LEUNG has placed a spy FONG LAI-KING (Zhao Ziqi) in the factory to wreak havoc. To make LEUNG give up on his acquisition plan, SUM decides to reveal a long-kept secret to him. SING invites his friend CHUNG LAM-TAI (Bosco Wong) to join his factory so that he no longer has to fight alone for the family business. But who would have thought that TAI is in no sense a blessing but just a wolf in sheep's clothing? SING gets betrayed by TAI, and worse than that, his fiancée CHUK YIU-KWAN (Song Wenfei) asks to cancel the wedding all of a sudden. The cold reality has eventually forced the lad into the fiercest commercial wars with his next of kin…

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. programme.title: EXTRA

Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Will Power
programme.desc: At court, two of the most famous lawyers in town YU YING-WAI (Wayne Lai) and LEE MING-YEUNG (Moses Chan) conduct tit-for-tat attacks on each other by any means necessary. YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. Such change catches a Senior Counsel LO SUM-PO's (Yueh Hua) eye, and he recruits YING-WAI to handle a litigation regarding the will of a late tycoon.

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Outbound Love
programme.desc: In order to develop new business, LAW SIK-SIK (Aimee Chan), who works for a travel agency, goes to Malaysia to have a meeting with her client. Unexpectedly, her plans are ruined by a local cunning tour guide, LUK KUNG-CHI (Ruco Chan), resulting in a falling-out between the two.

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.title: Eternal Happiness
programme.desc: KWUN's (YE MICHELLE) father YU (LO HOI PANG) used to be a royal doctor. Although he is a well-educated man, he believes that girls should stay home. KWUN wants to study, so she dresses up like a boy and attends a school. She meets a Mongolian Prince YI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and a Duke's son WAH (LAM RAYMOND) there and they become sworn brothers. YI knows that KWUN is a girl, but he does not unveil her secret. YU is planning to set up a marriage between her and WAH. Meanwhile, a wealthy merchant BIK (CHEUNG CHUNG CHI, DEON) also proposes to her parents for him to marry her. As the wedding day approaches, KWUN decides to tell YI her feelings. However, YI has to rush back home for his sick father, so he asks WAH to meet KWUN instead. KWUN is disappointed. She then decides to run away from home. Her masquerade as a boy causes many jokes and also drags her into many dangers. She has two puzzling affairs with both WAH and YI separately. Later, she finds out that WAH is her proposed fiance while YI is a prince…

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Comeback Clan, The
programme.desc: Severely hit by the financial storm, TAI KU-TUNG's (Ha Yu) restaurant is running short of capital. YIP MO-SING (Hui Shiu Hung) is coveting at the restaurant's location and so decides to invest in it, completely ignorant of its financial situation. Now that the restaurant's problem has been solved, TUNG gives himself over to working out new dishes. TSUI HEI-HEI (Sheung Tin Ngor) is a comer. This part-timer's egg fried rice has won the appreciation of the Michelin experts, and so TUNG treats her extremely well. A bank representative, LEI YUNG-CHI (Ng Wing Mei), pops in suddenly. HEI is a minibond victim. She picks up a fight with CHI as soon as she appears. HEI is injured and loses her memory. For fear that the restaurant's reputation will be ruined, TUNG decides to put on a make up show. While he himself pretends to be HEI's elder brother, SING acts as her husband. Cello teacher YIP TSIK-LEUNG (Sammul Chan) plays HEI's son. His girlfriend, TAI YING-LEI (Natalie Tong), who is TUNG's daughter, is assigned the role of HEI's cousin. In the meantime, YUNG is fired. Claiming that she is a shareholder, she plans to reform the restaurant. A triangular balance of power is developed as a result. To make things worse, the three owners are all harboring a sinister design…

programme.title: Chun Hui
programme.desc: Chun Hui tells the inspiring true story of Ge Jianhao, an extraordinary mother who broke away from feudal traditions in rural Hunan to pursue revolutionary ideals. After unbinding her feet, she defied poverty and social prejudice to move her family across China and all the way to France for a work-study program. Studying alongside the younger generation, she championed women's education and supported the early Communist movement. Through her unwavering guidance, her children—including key pioneers Cai Hesen, Cai Chang, and daughter-in-law Xiang Jingyu—became prominent leaders of the Communist Party of China.

programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. When show business declines after a decade, their choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the family's empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his father's followers fighting for control.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club's top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Ultimate Revenge
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As task force leader Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers. Old scores and new grievances collide as team member Cheung Ka Wo, driven by his brother's death, begins to unravel, and a brutal shootout uncovers a secret buried for years.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves "Frank," their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: The Leakers
programme.desc: A deadly artificial virus erupts in Malaysia as a listed pharmaceutical company exploits its monopoly on the cure for huge profits, resorting to murder to silence anyone who gets too close. A Hong Kong superintendent and a Malaysian inspector team up with a journalist, aided by the hacker collective “The Leakers”, to expose the corporate-political conspiracy.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmer's role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out…

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world…

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Big Times For The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: Kurangu Bommai
programme.desc: Sundaram, a loyal worker, and his son Kathir, a local cab driver, get entwined in their boss Ekambaram's evil plans that involve smuggling an idol and a bag full of money.

programme.title: CBI 5
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place one after another, a police officer decides to investigate the case himself and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Endrendrum Punnagai
programme.desc: Goutham grows up hating women after his mother abandons him during his childhood. Though he decides to stay single while his friends marry, Priya changes his mind about singlehood.

programme.title: Meyaadha Maan
programme.desc: Murali's friends prevent him from suicide when Madhu, the girl he loves, is about to get engaged. Later, they meet again at a friend's wedding and fall in love.

programme.title: Maargan
programme.desc: A gripping action drama following a determined protagonist facing challenges, uncovering truths, and fighting against injustice.

programme.title: Kaadan
programme.desc: Kaadan, a forest-raised man, vows to protect the jungle and its wildlife when he discovers a politician's plan to destroy it for a township.

programme.title: Burma Nagar Das
programme.desc: Follows a close circle of friends in a tiny village school. It seamlessly flashes between their past and present, highlighting the camaraderie and enthusiasm of their adolescence.

programme.title: Sowkarpettai
programme.desc: A couple is all set to get married, but an evil businessman kill them. The lovers then return as spirits to exact revenge on their perpetrators.

programme.title: Bhairavakottai
programme.desc: Basava and John, in a heist gone wrong, stumble upon mysteries in Bhairavakona, unraveling its secrets with Geetha's help.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Jamil sangat terkenal dengan sikap lurus bendulnya di kampung. Pasangannya, Mastora turut sama terikut perangai Jamil, namun begitu mereka tetap hidup bahagia meskipun tidak dikurniakan cahaya mata. Di kampung, oleh kerana Jamil seorang yang lurus bendul, orang kampung sering meminta bantuannya kerana Jamil pasti akan menyelesaikan masalah yang mereka hadapi dengan tindakan yang pelik. programme.title: Di Ambang Kasih

Penyatuan antara Rosdi dan Hidayu disedari oleh Haryati. Salah satu perkahwinan terpaksa digadaikan kerana status adik beradik antara mereka. Demi adik tersayang, Haryati rela mengorbankan cinta dan keluarganya.

programme.title: Bujang Selamat
programme.desc: Sering diganggu budak-budak di kampung, Bujang mula mempelajari ilmu persilatan. Bujang pergi mendaftarkan diri untuk bertanding di satu pertandingan silat namun telah diperli budak-budak lain. Rasa terhina, Bujang pun pergi bertemu seorang guru silat. Bersama guru itu, Bujang mempelajari teknik bersilat yang sangat hebat.

programme.title: Debu-Debu Kasih
programme.desc: Suzana baru pulang dari Amerika dengan membawa ijazah dalam bidang muzik. Dia mengikut kawannya Linda untuk bercuti di Terengganu. Di Terengganu, Suzana berkenalan dengan Sham - seorang pemuda yang suka menghabiskan masa dengan memerhatikan orang di jeti sambil bermain gitar. Suzana akhirnya membantu Sham sehingga menjadi seorang penyanyi yang berjaya dan telah jatuh cinta dengan Sham. Namun Suzana telah dikejutkan dengan perubahan sikap Sham secara tiba-tiba.

programme.title: Setinggan
programme.desc: Kawasan setinggan yang dibangunkan di tapak kubur tali barut Jepun menimbulkan kekacauan terhadap penduduk di situ. Hantu-hantu kubur tersebut merayau dan menganggu ketenteraman penduduk di situ - seorang dukun dijemput untuk menghalau hantu namun gagal. Satu insiden penculikan oleh hantu telah memaksa penduduk untuk bekerjasama dan memanggil dua dukun untuk menghalau hantu-hantu itu.

programme.title: Kecil-Kecil Cili Api
programme.desc: Abadi, budak berusia 10 tahun diculik oleh Muthu dan Misai di sebuah pusat membeli belah. Dia dibawa ke sebuah rumah di utara, di sana dia berjumpa Loloi dan Mei Mei. Ternyata mereka bertiga akan dibawa menyeberangi sempadan untuk dijual - tetapi mereka berjaya meloloskan diri. Mereka perlu mencari jalan untuk melarikan diri daripada kumpulan yang menculik mereka.

programme.title: Hantu Siang
programme.desc: Seorang kasanova yang suka menggoda gadis menerima padahnya apabila harus mengahwini mangsanya. Badul telah berjaya mendampingi lebih 17 gadis. Dia mempunyai rancangan untuk menggoda dua lagi gadis baru sebagai mangsanya. Rancangan Badul memakan diri apabila dia sendiri terpaksa menikahi mereka - cubaannya telah memerangkap dirinya sendiri.

programme.title: Sayang
programme.desc: Pelajar kolej swasta, Noni sering dikawal ketat oleh abangnya, Herman dan tidak boleh keluar bersosial seperti temannya yang lain. Herman mula bertindak menjadi ketua keluarga setelah kematian bapa mereka setahun yang lalu. Noni menghadiri satu majlis hari jadi dan terjadi sesuatu yang membuatkan Herman semakin ketat mengawal gerak geri Noni.

programme.title: Penyu
programme.desc: Yan, Abu, Yus dan Man diupah pakcik mereka, Chal untuk menjadi pemandu pelancong. Wazir, ketua kumpulan penunggang motosikal dan anaknya, Wati ingin membantu mereka untuk mempromosikan chalet milik pakcik mereka. Cappolla inginkan chalet tersebut untuk dijadikan kelab bagi melindungi kegiatan pelacuran. Mereka cuba untuk menghalang Cappolla namun terperangkap.

programme.title: Misteri Rumah Tua
programme.desc: Dendam lama mula terbalas apabila hadirnya sekumpulan remaja ke sebuah rumah lama yang dihuni roh wanita. Sebuah pembunuhan kejam telah berlaku di rumah tersebut apabila dia dirogol dan dibunuh ketika sedang sarat mengandung. Wanita tersebut ingin membalas dendam kerana ketidakadilan yang telah berlaku ketika dirinya masih hidup. Bapa kepada salah seorang dari kumpulan remaja tersebut pula pernah terlibat dengan pembunuhan kejam wanita itu yang menaikkan lagi rasa marah roh tersebut. Pelbagai insiden menyeramkan mula terjadi di rumah itu.

programme.title: SI Badol
programme.desc: Perjuangan kelas pekerja digambarkan apabila kapitalisme semakin mendapat tempat di dunia. Badol, seorang penipu, menyamar menjadi orang kaya yang datang dari Sarawak lalu mengahwini Milah. Tipu helah digunakannya untuk memperdaya orang kaya. Modus operandinya adalah dengan meminjam wang yang banyak. Badol pun pergi menghilangkan diri setelah berjaya memperdaya orang kaya.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Growing Through Life
programme.desc: HOI SING (Raymond Lam) and his mother HO WAI-SUM (Lui Yau Wai) have been running a domestic appliance manufacturing factory. SING's uncle HOI LEUNG (Lau Chung Yan) is a money-minded snob who has been seeking to acquire the factory by whatever means. LEUNG's wife CHENG MING-CHU (Cecilia Yip) and daughter HOI MEI-SZ (Toby Leung) try to intercede for SING and finally manages to convince the man to put the acquisition on hold. Eager to covet the plant site, LEUNG has placed a spy FONG LAI-KING (Zhao Ziqi) in the factory to wreak havoc. To make LEUNG give up on his acquisition plan, SUM decides to reveal a long-kept secret to him. SING invites his friend CHUNG LAM-TAI (Bosco Wong) to join his factory so that he no longer has to fight alone for the family business. But who would have thought that TAI is in no sense a blessing but just a wolf in sheep's clothing? SING gets betrayed by TAI, and worse than that, his fiancée CHUK YIU-KWAN (Song Wenfei) asks to cancel the wedding all of a sudden. The cold reality has eventually forced the lad into the fiercest commercial wars with his next of kin…

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Comeback Clan, The
programme.desc: Severely hit by the financial storm, TAI KU-TUNG's (Ha Yu) restaurant is running short of capital. YIP MO-SING (Hui Shiu Hung) is coveting at the restaurant's location and so decides to invest in it, completely ignorant of its financial situation. Now that the restaurant's problem has been solved, TUNG gives himself over to working out new dishes. TSUI HEI-HEI (Sheung Tin Ngor) is a comer. This part-timer's egg fried rice has won the appreciation of the Michelin experts, and so TUNG treats her extremely well. A bank representative, LEI YUNG-CHI (Ng Wing Mei), pops in suddenly. HEI is a minibond victim. She picks up a fight with CHI as soon as she appears. HEI is injured and loses her memory. For fear that the restaurant's reputation will be ruined, TUNG decides to put on a make up show. While he himself pretends to be HEI's elder brother, SING acts as her husband. Cello teacher YIP TSIK-LEUNG (Sammul Chan) plays HEI's son. His girlfriend, TAI YING-LEI (Natalie Tong), who is TUNG's daughter, is assigned the role of HEI's cousin. In the meantime, YUNG is fired. Claiming that she is a shareholder, she plans to reform the restaurant. A triangular balance of power is developed as a result. To make things worse, the three owners are all harboring a sinister design…

programme.title: Eternal Happiness
programme.desc: KWUN's (YE MICHELLE) father YU (LO HOI PANG) used to be a royal doctor. Although he is a well-educated man, he believes that girls should stay home. KWUN wants to study, so she dresses up like a boy and attends a school. She meets a Mongolian Prince YI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and a Duke's son WAH (LAM RAYMOND) there and they become sworn brothers. YI knows that KWUN is a girl, but he does not unveil her secret. YU is planning to set up a marriage between her and WAH. Meanwhile, a wealthy merchant BIK (CHEUNG CHUNG CHI, DEON) also proposes to her parents for him to marry her. As the wedding day approaches, KWUN decides to tell YI her feelings. However, YI has to rush back home for his sick father, so he asks WAH to meet KWUN instead. KWUN is disappointed. She then decides to run away from home. Her masquerade as a boy causes many jokes and also drags her into many dangers. She has two puzzling affairs with both WAH and YI separately. Later, she finds out that WAH is her proposed fiance while YI is a prince…

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

This part-timer's egg fried rice has won the appreciation of the Michelin experts, and so TUNG treats her extremely well. A bank representative, LEI YUNG-CHI (Ng Wing Mei), pops in suddenly. HEI is a minibond victim. She picks up a fight with CHI as soon as she appears. HEI is injured and loses her memory. For fear that the restaurant's reputation will be ruined, TUNG decides to put on a make up show. While he himself pretends to be HEI's elder brother, SING acts as her husband. Cello teacher YIP TSIK-LEUNG (Sammul Chan) plays HEI's son. His girlfriend, TAI YING-LEI (Natalie Tong), who is TUNG's daughter, is assigned the role of HEI's cousin. In the meantime, YUNG is fired. Claiming that she is a shareholder, she plans to reform the restaurant. A triangular balance of power is developed as a result. To make things worse, the three owners are all harboring a sinister design…

programme.title: Eternal Happiness
programme.desc: KWUN's (YE MICHELLE) father YU (LO HOI PANG) used to be a royal doctor. Although he is a well-educated man, he believes that girls should stay home. KWUN wants to study, so she dresses up like a boy and attends a school. She meets a Mongolian Prince YI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and a Duke's son WAH (LAM RAYMOND) there and they become sworn brothers. YI knows that KWUN is a girl, but he does not unveil her secret. YU is planning to set up a marriage between her and WAH. Meanwhile, a wealthy merchant BIK (CHEUNG CHUNG CHI, DEON) also proposes to her parents for him to marry her. As the wedding day approaches, KWUN decides to tell YI her feelings. However, YI has to rush back home for his sick father, so he asks WAH to meet KWUN instead. KWUN is disappointed. She then decides to run away from home. Her masquerade as a boy causes many jokes and also drags her into many dangers. She has two puzzling affairs with both WAH and YI separately. Later, she finds out that WAH is her proposed fiance while YI is a prince…

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Chun Hui
programme.desc: Chun Hui tells the inspiring true story of Ge Jianhao, an extraordinary mother who broke away from feudal traditions in rural Hunan to pursue revolutionary ideals. After unbinding her feet, she defied poverty and social prejudice to move her family across China and all the way to France for a work-study program. Studying alongside the younger generation, she championed women's education and supported the early Communist movement. Through her unwavering guidance, her children—including key pioneers Cai Hesen, Cai Chang, and daughter-in-law Xiang Jingyu—became prominent leaders of the Communist Party of China.

programme.title: Yu Xue Rong Guang
programme.desc: Yu Xue Rong Guang covers the critical period from the 1927 Nanchang Uprising to the 1935 Zunyi Conference. The drama chronicles the birth of China's Red Army through major historical milestones, including the Jinggang Mountains base, the Gutian Conference, and the Long March. Through grueling battles and key political decisions, it shows how early revolutionaries built a resilient military from scratch and established the path to victory.
