programme.title: Ultimate Revenge
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As task force leader Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers. Old scores and new grievances collide as team member Cheung Ka Wo, driven by his brother's death, begins to unravel, and a brutal shootout uncovers a secret buried for years.

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Joe is a 20-something slacker who only takes one thing seriously: his on-and-off girlfriend Flora. After their latest breakup, Joe goes to an audition for a documentary by director Barbara Wong. Handed a camera, Joe records his discovery of a magical website that reunites him with Flora at the price of breaking up his best friend and his girlfriend. However, despite the efficiency of the website, Joe's refusal to change his immature ways and Flora's attraction to a talented graffiti artist threatens to break them up once more.

programme.title: Operation Hadal
programme.desc: An elite deep-sea special forces unit teams up with the submarine “Long Jing” to thwart an international super-submarine conspiracy. Facing enemy ambushes and navigating treacherous waters, they dive into a dangerous underwater battlefield, where a life-or-death showdown unfolds beneath the sea.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping shocked China by coaching Team USA to victory against her home nation. Years later, when China's women's volleyball team fell into a slump, she returned to rebuild the squad and eventually led them to a historic gold medal triumph at the Rio 2016 Olympics.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank & returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Pass and Goal
programme.desc: After a stock crash wipes out everything she has built, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a grassroots kids' football team. Guided by a disabled coach, they prepare to face an elite squad backed by wealthy families. Caught between ambition and conscience, she resolves to use her second half to rewrite the children's first.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse “Red Hare” to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, “Red Hare” may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: In a chilly winter, De and his family goes on a self-drive tour to Changbai Mountain. The holiday turns tragic when De's eight-year-old son goes missing. He seeks help from the local police but is unable to find his son. Though the golden hour has passed, De and the rescue team insist on continuing the search. Can they finally rescue the boy?

programme.title: Man On The Edge
programme.desc: On the eve of the 1997 handover, violence is rampant with triad forces causing chaos in Hong Kong. The triad gang leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families. From the struggles at home to challenges in relationships and conflicts at work, these three women rise with strength when faced with plights unknown.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wang's only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: Several down-and-out individuals find a spark in esports. From a cybercafé to the competitive arena, they form team “Happy Hour”, battling rivals and life's setbacks to reclaim a second chance.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancée Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case…

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly “Iron Fist” technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands while drunk. His brother's wife, Pan Jin Lian, tries to seduce him, but he refuses. Pan later has an affair with a wealthy man, and the lovers poison her husband to death. Upon learning the truth, Wu Song kills them both to avenge his brother.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the “walls”?

programme.title: Jawaan
programme.desc: The film explores themes of vengeance and justice, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats.

programme.title: Kathar Basha Endra Muthuramalingam
programme.desc: Nana, a powerful gangster, vies for control of a village. However, Kathar, an honest man, strives for peace, resulting in a clash between the two.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Kalavani 2
programme.desc: Arivazhagan files his candidature for the panchayat elections hoping to profit from the two competing parties, comprising of his uncle and his lady-love's father.

programme.title: Maniyaar Kudumbam
programme.desc: Kutti Maniyar avoids working and lives off his inherited money and property. However, he decides to turn over a new leaf when he falls in love.

programme.title: Nagaraja Cholan MA, MLA
programme.desc: A political satire, the movie chronicles the highs and lows of Nagaraja Cholan, a deputy Chief Minister's ambitious career.

programme.title: Brothers Day
programme.desc: Ronny meets Chandy and the two become very close. However, an unexpected series of events take place when the latter reveals his true identity.

programme.title: Savarakathi
programme.desc: A barber has a bad encounter with a gangster on the road and this results in him running all over the city to save himself.

programme.title: Radhe Shyam
programme.desc: In 1970s Europe, a world-renowned palmist named Vikramaditya finds love when he meets Prerana, a doctor. However, their relationship is threatened by his view of destiny and a terminal illness.

programme.title: Varappogum 24 Manikkul
programme.desc: A gripping thriller unfolding over 24 intense hours, where choices shape destinies, secrets unravel, and time becomes the ultimate test of survival.

programme.title: Guru Aur Bhole
programme.desc: Guru's onomatopoeic singing talents adds to Bhole's unique dancing style and brute strength which helps them to get out of many sticky situations in this animated musical comedy.

programme.title: Honey Bunny & The Talking Statues
programme.desc: A hilarious animal chase comedy about the secret life and adventures of a dog, a parrot and twin bobcats living with Ms Katkar

programme.title: Baalveer

programme.desc: Tish menemui sesuatu dari zaman kanak-kanaknya sementara Val bersedia untuk tinggal bersama Calvin. Frances merancang untuk mengumpulkan seluruh kumpulan k-drama semula, dan Jay memutuskan nasib ladang keluarga. Sheila mula berjumpa ahli terapi.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Harris mula menyedari perasaannya yang semakin mendalam terhadap Ameena, sementara Ameena pula terpaksa berdepan satu realiti baharu yang langsung tidak pernah dia jangkakan, sesuatu yang mengubah segalanya. Dalam masa yang sama, Maria sedar dia perlu bertindak lebih ekstrem jika benar-benar mahu menang.

programme.desc: Podcast Lagenda membawakan Zul Nadzar, seorang ahli muzik dan komposer. Beliau berkongsi perjalanan karier, fasa cabaran dalam industri, serta perubahan yang membentuk dirinya sehingga berjaya mencapai tahap sekarang. Ikuti kisah inspirasi beliau dalam rancangan bual bicara santai ini!

programme.title: Bro, Nampak Motor Gua?
programme.desc: Epol membeli motosikal baru menggunakan simpanannya, kemudian membawanya untuk ditunjuk-tunjuk. Malangnya, motosikal itu dicuri oleh dua pencuri. Semasa mencari motornya, Epol bertembung dengan Azura yang beg tangannya turut diragut oleh kumpulan yang sama. Dipecah dalam beg Azura ialah thumb drive yang mengandungi maklumat penting milik Tan Sri Bakhtiar, seorang ahli perniagaan ternama.

programme.title: Danur 2: Maddah
programme.desc: Memandangkan keupayaan Risa untuk melihat hantu terus mengganggu kehidupannya, kelakuan pelik bapa saudaranya membawa kepada penemuan satu misteri menyeramkan di rumah baharu lelaki itu.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand (Dia Perempuan Sialan) EP12
programme.desc: Apabila roh jahat itu melampiaskan kemurkaan sepenuhnya terhadap anak dalam kandungan Nerina, Riska berjuang bermati-matian untuk mendapatkan semula jiwanya.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP12
programme.desc: Pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari dengan dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan berada di Desa Rhu, Johor. Kisah misteri dan mistik yang ingin diterokai minggu ini adalah tentang pembinaan kawasan perumahan yang terbengkalai. Pengantara menemu bual Ateh seorang penduduk tempatan, Ateh pernah mengalami kejadian menakutkan semasa masuk ke binaan terbiar tersebut. Aktivis Para Normal Amir Yusop berkongsi pengalaman semasa membuat pengambaran di sana termasuk berjumpa dengan lembaga perempuan. Pengantara bersama krew dan Amir kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di lokasi tersebut selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi yang menakutkan dan penampakan sama saperti diceritakan.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK), kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato' Hashim. Ketika Dato' Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Bodyguard
programme.desc: Seorang lelaki yang kehilangan cinta dan keinginan untuk hidup terserempak dengan seorang wanita yang dikejar oleh penyerang yang tidak dikenali. Dia adalah satu-satunya pewaris perbadanan itu. Dan dia telah dikejar oleh seseorang yang cuba melucutkan syarikat itu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Jack, seorang profesor arkeologi yang terkenal di dunia, dan pasukannya sedang dalam pencarian besar-besaran untuk mencari harta karun purba India yang hilang apabila mereka diserang hendap oleh sekumpulan tentera upahan dan dibiarkan mati.

programme.title: Agrinai
programme.desc: Di sebuah rumah terpencil, eksperimen psikologi jenayah dengan tiga pembunuh bersiri psikopat, mesin AI dan LSD yang kuat menjadi huru-hara apabila pembunuh melarikan diri, mengganas penduduk tempatan dan mendekati keluarganya, mendedahkan motif gelap dan kelainan yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: KL Zombie
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Nipis, seorang pemalas yang menjadi wira tanpa rela apabila wabak zombi merampas satu-satunya kehidupan yang dikenalnya.

programme.title: Kongsi
programme.desc: Kongsi merupakan sebuah filem aksi komedi mengisahkan penyiasatan ASP Shariff (Fizo Omar) terhadap kes pembunuhan dikalangan kumpulan kongsi gelap di Kuala Lumpur. Kumpulan kongsi gelap yang terdiri dari tiga kaum utama Melayu, Cina dan India ini menjadi huru hara dengan kematian seorang demi seorang ahlinya. Pergaduhan besar hampir berlaku kerana mereka saling tuduh menuduh antara satu sama lain apabila berlaku pembunuhan.

programme.title: Bayangan Dendam EP4
programme.desc: Ariana mengesyaki Farhan bertemu dengan Melissa secara rahsia, manakala Melissa mendedahkan adanya kebocoran di dalam Rose Textiles.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: A Perfect Enemy
programme.desc: Seorang arkitek yang berjaya didekati oleh seorang gadis yang peramah semasa dia berada di Lapangan Terbang Paris. Walaupun pertemuan itu kelihatan seperti satu kebetulan, keadaan tidak lama kemudian berubah, mengubah pertemuan tersebut menjadi sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat dan bersifat jenayah.

programme.title: Bayangan Dendam EP3
programme.desc: Bertekad untuk memulihkan persahabatan mereka yang telah retak, Ariana menghubungi Melissa. Dalam pada itu, usaha terdesak Azura untuk menyelamatkan bapa saudaranya yang dibelenggu hutang membawa kepada satu kesilapan yang mengancam segala-galanya.

programme.title: Aku Yang Kau Gelar Isteri EP1
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ezlan, Raihani dan Laila berkawan baik semenjak dari zaman persekolahan. Ibu Ezlan mahu anaknya meneruskan pelajaran ke universiti.

programme.title: Sahak Gangster
programme.desc: Sahak diburu kumpulan kongsi gelap dan polis selepas dituduh membunuh ketua sendiri. Bersembunyi bersama Suriani, dia tekad menunaikan amanat Pak Andak, mencari dalang pembunuhan dan membalas dendam, walau dirinya menjadi suspek utama.

programme.desc: Berita Tengah Malam yang memaparkan perkembangan terkini, isu-isu semasa dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Kasih Malisa
programme.desc:
Malisa, seorang wanita baik hati, lembut namun tegas yang datang ke Kuala Lumpur untuk bekerja. Di tempat kerja, dia berkenalan dengan Salmi, Faridah, Adib dan Azman, namun kehadirannya pada awalnya tidak disenangi Faridah. Pelbagai konflik, suka duka dan pengalaman dilalui Malisa bersama rakan-rakan baharunya.
Pelakon : Zara Zya, Fizz Fairuz, Qazem Nor, Zarina Zainoordin, Shakilla Khoriri, Zachery Francis, Roy Azman, Watie Sadali, Lydiawati dan Ridzuan Hashim.

programme.title: Diari Borneo

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Growing Through Life
programme.desc: HOI SING (Raymond Lam) and his mother HO WAI-SUM (Lui Yau Wai) have been running a domestic appliance manufacturing factory. SING's uncle HOI LEUNG (Lau Chung Yan) is a money-minded snob who has been seeking to acquire the factory by whatever means. LEUNG's wife CHENG MING-CHU (Cecilia Yip) and daughter HOI MEI-SZ (Toby Leung) try to intercede for SING and finally manages to convince the man to put the acquisition on hold. Eager to covet the plant site, LEUNG has placed a spy FONG LAI-KING (Zhao Ziqi) in the factory to wreak havoc. To make LEUNG give up on his acquisition plan, SUM decides to reveal a long-kept secret to him. SING invites his friend CHUNG LAM-TAI (Bosco Wong) to join his factory so that he no longer has to fight alone for the family business. But who would have thought that TAI is in no sense a blessing but just a wolf in sheep's clothing? SING gets betrayed by TAI, and worse than that, his fiancée CHUK YIU-KWAN (Song Wenfei) asks to cancel the wedding all of a sudden. The cold reality has eventually forced the lad into the fiercest commercial wars with his next of kin…

programme.title: Seoul follow me! & What's On Today
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Global View

programme.title: Comeback Clan, The
programme.desc: Severely hit by the financial storm, TAI KU-TUNG's (Ha Yu) restaurant is running short of capital. YIP MO-SING (Hui Shiu Hung) is coveting at the restaurant's location and so decides to invest in it, completely ignorant of its financial situation. Now that the restaurant's problem has been solved, TUNG gives himself over to working out new dishes. TSUI HEI-HEI (Sheung Tin Ngor) is a comer. This part-timer's egg fried rice has won the appreciation of the Michelin experts, and so TUNG treats her extremely well. A bank representative, LEI YUNG-CHI (Ng Wing Mei), pops in suddenly. HEI is a minibond victim. She picks up a fight with CHI as soon as she appears. HEI is injured and loses her memory. For fear that the restaurant's reputation will be ruined, TUNG decides to put on a make up show. While he himself pretends to be HEI's elder brother, SING acts as her husband. Cello teacher YIP TSIK-LEUNG (Sammul Chan) plays HEI's son. His girlfriend, TAI YING-LEI (Natalie Tong), who is TUNG's daughter, is assigned the role of HEI's cousin. In the meantime, YUNG is fired. Claiming that she is a shareholder, she plans to reform the restaurant. A triangular balance of power is developed as a result. To make things worse, the three owners are all harboring a sinister design…

programme.title: Eternal Happiness
programme.desc: KWUN's (YE MICHELLE) father YU (LO HOI PANG) used to be a royal doctor. Although he is a well-educated man, he believes that girls should stay home. KWUN wants to study, so she dresses up like a boy and attends a school. She meets a Mongolian Prince YI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and a Duke's son WAH (LAM RAYMOND) there and they become sworn brothers. YI knows that KWUN is a girl, but he does not unveil her secret. YU is planning to set up a marriage between her and WAH. Meanwhile, a wealthy merchant BIK (CHEUNG CHUNG CHI, DEON) also proposes to her parents for him to marry her. As the wedding day approaches, KWUN decides to tell YI her feelings. However, YI has to rush back home for his sick father, so he asks WAH to meet KWUN instead. KWUN is disappointed. She then decides to run away from home. Her masquerade as a boy causes many jokes and also drags her into many dangers. She has two puzzling affairs with both WAH and YI separately. Later, she finds out that WAH is her proposed fiance while YI is a prince…

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: Fraudstars
programme.desc: Award-winning novice director Chan Chi-yeung (Pierre Ngo) insists on his own way, causing showbiz people to distance themselves from him and the artistic director of the film crew. Fast-forward ten years and Chi-yeung, producer Herman (Lawrence Cheng), screenwriter Lee Sa-sa (Angel Chiang), martial arts choreographer Master Man (Lam Wai), production designer Shell (Kirby Lam), actress Lau Ka-ling (Sammi Cheung) and assistant director Choi Tsz-lok (Enson Lau) meet up again as they want to launch a project with the objective of making their best movie. Their dream is shattered when the investor accidentally dies. They even have to settle a big restaurant bill. To let themselves off the hook, the septet showcase a seemingly believable scam. Chi-yeung then brings the chums together to establish “Fraudstars”. Until one day, a real crime syndicate show up to force them to have the only option of engaging in a scam.

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

Cello teacher YIP TSIK-LEUNG (Sammul Chan) plays HEI's son. His girlfriend, TAI YING-LEI (Natalie Tong), who is TUNG's daughter, is assigned the role of HEI's cousin. In the meantime, YUNG is fired. Claiming that she is a shareholder, she plans to reform the restaurant. A triangular balance of power is developed as a result. To make things worse, the three owners are all harboring a sinister design…

programme.title: Eternal Happiness
programme.desc: KWUN's (YE MICHELLE) father YU (LO HOI PANG) used to be a royal doctor. Although he is a well-educated man, he believes that girls should stay home. KWUN wants to study, so she dresses up like a boy and attends a school. She meets a Mongolian Prince YI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and a Duke's son WAH (LAM RAYMOND) there and they become sworn brothers. YI knows that KWUN is a girl, but he does not unveil her secret. YU is planning to set up a marriage between her and WAH. Meanwhile, a wealthy merchant BIK (CHEUNG CHUNG CHI, DEON) also proposes to her parents for him to marry her. As the wedding day approaches, KWUN decides to tell YI her feelings. However, YI has to rush back home for his sick father, so he asks WAH to meet KWUN instead. KWUN is disappointed. She then decides to run away from home. Her masquerade as a boy causes many jokes and also drags her into many dangers. She has two puzzling affairs with both WAH and YI separately. Later, she finds out that WAH is her proposed fiance while YI is a prince…

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: Fraudstars
programme.desc: Award-winning novice director Chan Chi-yeung (Pierre Ngo) insists on his own way, causing showbiz people to distance themselves from him and the artistic director of the film crew. Fast-forward ten years and Chi-yeung, producer Herman (Lawrence Cheng), screenwriter Lee Sa-sa (Angel Chiang), martial arts choreographer Master Man (Lam Wai), production designer Shell (Kirby Lam), actress Lau Ka-ling (Sammi Cheung) and assistant director Choi Tsz-lok (Enson Lau) meet up again as they want to launch a project with the objective of making their best movie. Their dream is shattered when the investor accidentally dies. They even have to settle a big restaurant bill. To let themselves off the hook, the septet showcase a seemingly believable scam. Chi-yeung then brings the chums together to establish “Fraudstars”. Until one day, a real crime syndicate show up to force them to have the only option of engaging in a scam.

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Yu Xue Rong Guang
programme.desc: Yu Xue Rong Guang covers the critical period from the 1927 Nanchang Uprising to the 1935 Zunyi Conference. The drama chronicles the birth of China's Red Army through major historical milestones, including the Jinggang Mountains base, the Gutian Conference, and the Long March. Through grueling battles and key political decisions, it shows how early revolutionaries built a resilient military from scratch and established the path to victory.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: Several down-and-out individuals find a spark in esports. From a cybercafé to the competitive arena, they form team “Happy Hour”, battling rivals and life's setbacks to reclaim a second chance.

programme.title: Prosecutor, The
programme.desc: Based on a true case, the film follows young Ma Jia Jie, who pleads guilty to drug trafficking in exchange for a lighter sentence as coerced by his defense lawyer. Huo Zi Hao, a former cop turned prosecutor, believes in his innocence and launches an investigation. Risking his life and career, Huo is determined to uncover the real perpetrator.

programme.title: Hk Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee is the Production head of an advertising firm who tries to improve her team's performance by competing with Creative head Chan in the day and clubbing at Lan Kwai Fong for ideas at night. Lee runs into her ex-boyfriend before a big commercial shoot and drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong, but finally picks herself up with Chan's help.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being reassigned to a new station. Initially, Wang disagrees with Ma's unconventional methods, but over time, Ma helps him rediscover the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life.

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: Constable Li Mao marries a rich girl but her parents disapprove of their marriage. One day, Li accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince! While he aims to secure a high ranking position in the palace, the prince wants freedom, so they decide to switch identities. This however, got them both involved in the minister's conspiracy…

programme.title: Someday Or One Day
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers she's unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Ultimate Revenge
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As task force leader Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers. Old scores and new grievances collide as team member Cheung Ka Wo, driven by his brother's death, begins to unravel, and a brutal shootout uncovers a secret buried for years.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world where humans have ceased to dream, a monster drifts through the fading illusions of the dreamworld. Clinging to visions no one else can see, its solitude is interrupted by a woman uniquely gifted to perceive these hidden dreams. Choosing to step into the monster's dreams, she seeks the truth that lies hidden within.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the “walls”?

programme.title: The Devil's Mirror
programme.desc: A power-hungry Witch who leads the Bloody Ghouls Clan, seeks two magical mirrors, Wind Mirror and Thunder Mirror, which are owned by Bai and the Wen Clan respectively. She needs both mirrors to find the location of a powerful weapon that will make her invincible and will stop at nothing to get her hands on them.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed “The Invincible Fist” is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Na Cha The Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancée enlists a swordsman—who secretly loves her—to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love…

programme.title: Heaven Sword And Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from “Nine Yang Scriptures” by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Varappogum 24 Manikkul
programme.desc: A gripping thriller unfolding over 24 intense hours, where choices shape destinies, secrets unravel, and time becomes the ultimate test of survival.

programme.title: Arasangam
programme.desc: Arivarasu goes to Canada to search for his missing brother-in-law. However, he discovers a plot by terrorists to kill all intellectuals in India and stop the country's growth.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Irumbu Thirai
programme.desc: A military officer borrows money for his sister's marriage using fake papers. When the money goes missing from his account, he embarks on an investigation that uncovers a hacker.

programme.title: Kayal
programme.desc: Aaron falls in love with Kayalvizhi at first sight but she does not reciprocate. They have to part ways when she starts developing feelings for him.

programme.title: Republic
programme.desc: An IIT gold medalist dives into the Indian Administrative Services, navigating challenges and conflicts with the fresh political establishment. It's a journey of ambition and resilience!

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: Anuradha is hired by Gopala, a businessman. Although she loves him, she is soon fired. She then learns about his past and must also deal with her replacement Shruti, who has an agenda of her own.

programme.title: Mehendi Circus
programme.desc: A music shop owner's heart is captured by a captivating circus performer, but societal barriers of caste and class threaten their budding romance and happiness.

programme.title: Kattappava Kanom
programme.desc: A newlywed couple's lives are hilariously upended when their lucky pet fish, Kattappa, goes missing, leading to unforeseen consequences and dark comedic situations.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: A young woman buys a vintage car that behaves oddly, only to discover it's possessed by a vengeful spirit connected to her past.
